create.name: Satchidananda Ashram–Yogaville
create.bio:
Satchidananda Ashram–Yogaville is the residential ashram and world headquarters of Integral Yoga, founded by Sri Swami Satchidananda, the Sivananda disciple who opened Woodstock in 1969 and taught in the United States from 1966 until his death in 2002. It stands on some 750 acres beside the James River in Buckingham County, central Virginia, with a teaching academy, monastery, library, guest housing and the Light Of Truth Universal Shrine (LOTUS), a lotus-shaped interfaith temple opened in 1986 with altars for the world's faiths. His interred remains lie at the Chidambaram shrine on the grounds, and monastics, ministers and lay residents carry the teaching on.

The Integral Yoga Academy has trained teachers for over fifty years; its 200-hour course now combines an online first part with a residential fortnight at the ashram and leads to Integral Yoga Level I certification, and it also runs meditation and advanced trainings, including one at the Coimbatore institute in India. Guests can come for silent retreats with daily postures, breathing, deep relaxation, meditation and philosophy, for weekend workshops on chanting, qigong or the mind, or for the 28-day Living Yoga Training of practice and service in community. Weekly satsangs and kirtan concerts are streamed on its YouTube channel.

courses.title: 200-Hour Integral Yoga Teacher Training (Part 1 online, Part 2 at Yogaville)
courses.description: A two-part teacher training: ten weeks online from February to April 2027, then two weeks in residence at the ashram in August. It covers hatha practice and teaching, the Yoga Sutras, the six branches of Integral Yoga, anatomy and practice teaching, leading to the Level I diploma.
courses.price: $4,200 for the full 200-hour training ($100.00 off if paid in full by Nov 15, 2026)

courses.title: Meditation Teacher Training in India
courses.description: A two-week certification course in Integral Yoga meditation held at the Integral Yoga Institute in Coimbatore, near Swami Satchidananda's birthplace, led by Swami Ramananda and Ram Wiener. Shared rooms and vegetarian meals are included.
courses.price: $2,550.00 – Double Accommodations ($2400 if paid in full by November 9, 2026)

courses.title: Spring Silent Retreat: Reconnect, Renew, Restore
courses.description: Four days held in silence at the ashram with Swami Divyananda Ma and Swan Michelle, with classes in postures, breathing, deep relaxation, meditation and yoga philosophy, and private mentoring on request.

courses.title: A New Year Journey: 19 Days of Yoga and Meditation (Online)
courses.description: A daily online practice led live on Zoom by Saci Murphy, Yogaville's executive director: a short contemplative teaching, a guided meditation and an Integral Yoga class each day, with recordings for those who cannot join live.

courses.title: Living Yoga Training (LYT)
courses.description: A 28-day residential immersion in ashram life, with daily group meditations, a morning hatha class, spiritual study and karma yoga service alongside the resident community. Applicants are screened and start on set dates.

free_resources.title: Integral Yoga Hatha Class (free full-length class)
free_resources.description: A complete hour-long Integral Yoga Level I class on video, with postures, deep relaxation, breathing and a short meditation, which the ashram suggests to newcomers before teacher training.

Guests: Krishna Das and Nina Rao (both on Spiritpedia) appear in kirtan videos on the ashram's channel as visiting musicians; not linked (guests). The Krishna Das kirtan video is kept as a video item; owner may prefer to drop it as music-only.
